description: Part B of conj:dilogarithm-archimedean-limit (the open substrate q→1⁺ continuation). The bare q-Pochhammer object diverges at q₀=1.11 (branch-cut iπ tower past k*=log_{q₀}(1/x)); the exact algebraic-pole subtraction (log(x qᵏ)+iπ, no free parameter) yields reg(x)→Li₂(x)−π²/3, reproducing Li₂(x)'s x-dependence to machine precision (substrate + q→1⁺ limit) with a universal x-independent offset π²/3 = Li₂(1) branch point + Euler tail (∫₀^∞log(1−e^{−s})ds=−π²/6). data.verdict: Part B ADVANCED (scope-(a) positive-partial). The substrate q→1⁺ continuation of the q-Pochhammer partial product, with the exact algebraic-pole subtraction (log(x qᵏ)+iπ for the negative factors — no free parameter), reproduces the FULL x-dependence of Li₂(x) to machine precision, at the substrate q₀=1.11 and in the q→1⁺ limit, offset by the UNIVERSAL x-independent constant π²/3 = 2·(π²/6) (the Li₂(1) branch point + the negative-factor Euler tail). The bare object diverges (Re & Im, the branch-cut iπ tower) — that is audit gap (2), concretely located at k*=log_{q₀}(1/x). Categorical tie-down: the GENUINE T_w mechanism is the stratified-truncation corollary (prop:quantum-dilogarithm-stratified) — the Frobenius trace tr_M(Φ_q·T_w) truncates at k*(T_w), so the divergent k>k* (Euler-tail) factors are never paired; the truncated categorical object Φ^{[≤k*]} → Li₂(x) − π²/6, removing exactly ONE of the two π²/6 halves. The residual offset is then the SINGLE regulator constant π²/6 = ζ(2) = Li₂(1) — the cusp/branch-point value (conj:shared-denominator-cusp-holonomy: the k* root x=q₀^{-k*} is the cusp-completeness address). So 'exact cancellation among algebraic poles' resolves to: T_w truncation removes the tail π²/6 categorically, leaving the archimedean regulator ζ(2)=Li₂(1). The x-dependence of Li₂(x) is CONFIRMED exact; the residual open content is the single regulator constant (the cusp-boundary term at x=1), not a functional obstruction. No fit; nothing wired; block stays kind:conjecture (the cusp-boundary ζ(2) term and the x→1⁻ edge remain).
